instruction: With ANSYS Mechanical APDL, build and solve a 3D solid cantilever beam under an eccentric end load. For this workflow, open Mechanical APDL from `C:\Program Files\ANSYS Inc\v261\ansys\bin\winx64\ANSYS261.exe`. Coordinate system and geometry: - Use the global Cartesian coordinate system. - The beam occupies 0 <= X <= 150 mm, 0 <= Y <= 20 mm, and 0 <= Z <= 10 mm. - The fixed end is the face X = 0 mm. - The load point is the corner (150, 20, 10) mm on the free end. Model parameters: - Material: linear elastic steel. - Young's modulus E = 210000 MPa. - Poisson's ratio = 0.3. - Element type: SOLID185. Mesh: - Use a mapped/swept hexahedral mesh with a 5 mm element size in X, Y, and Z. - Use 30 divisions along X, 4 divisions along Y, and 2 divisions along Z. Boundary conditions and load: - Fully constrain UX, UY, and UZ on the face X = 0 mm. - Apply a concentrated FY = -200 N at (150, 20, 10) mm. Analysis type: - Static structural analysis. Save requirements: - Use C:\Users\user\Desktop as the ANSYS working directory. - Save the database file as C:\Users\user\Desktop\apdl_eccentric_beam.db. - Save the structural result file as C:\Users\user\Desktop\apdl_eccentric_beam.rst. - Run the solver to completion and save the final solved state in both files.
